headline: Huang's return sparks a huge tech rebound
context: Nvidia's board brought back Jensen Huang as chief executive, and last week's heavy AI selling turned into a broad rally.
chart_title: Tech led the rally, energy slipped

NVDA.text: Its board reinstated Jensen Huang as chief executive, less than two weeks after he resigned.

DELL.text: AI server makers rallied with Nvidia a day before Dell's quarterly results. Peers such as HPE also jumped.

MU.text: Its memory chips go into Nvidia's AI processors, and Huang's return eased fears of an AI slowdown.

CRWD.text: Agreed to buy rival Zscaler in an all-stock deal worth about $43.9 billion, overshadowing record quarterly results.

IP.text: No company news. It fell even as other packaging makers rose with the wider market.

ELV.text: No company news. Health insurers fell together on a day when most of the market rallied.

watch.title: Dell earnings
watch.text: A test of demand for AI servers after the tech sell-off.

watch.title: Inflation and GDP data
watch.text: PCE, the Fed's preferred inflation gauge, plus a revised Q3 growth figure.

question: Is Huang's return enough to end the AI sell-off?
